errors.text_span: 而“GPT-4”和“Claude3”模型的柱状图高度依次递减
errors.evidence: This statement claims that the bar heights for GPT-4 and Claude3 decrease sequentially. While this is true for the blue bars (AI domain: 73.23% > 62.91%), it is false for the orange bars (Engineering domain: 50.32% < 52.71%). Therefore, this is an incorrect generalization of the trend.
